snippet.title: POSTAL: These Sunny Daze DLC Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WHAT?! A NEW DLC?!
AM I TRIPPIN’ DUDE?!

POSTAL: These Sunny Daze DLC is real - and it’s hitting this August to leave you with serious P:TSD!

P:TSD picks up right where your last Brain-Damaged fever dream collapsed - cracks your skull open, lays your brain out to tan, and lets it roast under the sun until it shrivels up like a pensioner sunbathing too long at a budget beach resort, just trying to catch that burnt-orange glow before the bingo starts.

This isn’t “just a DLC” - it’s a tropical serotonin collapse packed with juicy carnage, alleged jokes, overbaked new levels, even less appropriate enemies, and “who okay’d this?” weapon design - with another mag of SPF-free mockery fired point-blank at modern life.
No one’s safe under the sun. So don’t laugh too soon.

The action’s nastier, the pacing’s feral - and it hits that unhinged boomer-shooter sweet spot even harder this time.

Smash that wishlist button like it owes you:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3768390/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged__These_Sunny_Daze/

JOIN DISCORD: https://discord.gg/RmSMErHxwj
